targets.rawSql: select now() as time, count(*) as value from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${conversation_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or conversation_id = ${conversation_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${tool:sqlstring} = '__all' or tool_name = ${tool:sqlstring});

select now() as time, count(distinct conversation_id) as value from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and conversation_id is not null and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${conversation_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or conversation_id = ${conversation_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${tool:sqlstring} = '__all' or tool_name = ${tool:sqlstring});

select now() as time, coalesce(round(100.0 * avg(case when tool_success = true then 1.0 when tool_success = false then 0.0 else null end), 2), 0) as value from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${conversation_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or conversation_id = ${conversation_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${tool:sqlstring} = '__all' or tool_name = ${tool:sqlstring});

select now() as time, coalesce(round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by tool_duration_ms))::numeric, 2), 0) as value from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and tool_duration_ms is not null and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${conversation_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or conversation_id = ${conversation_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${tool:sqlstring} = '__all' or tool_name = ${tool:sqlstring});

with filtered as (select * from codex_tool_events_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${conversation_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or conversation_id = ${conversation_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${tool:sqlstring} = '__all' or tool_name = ${tool:sqlstring})) select tool_name, sum(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_decision' then 1 else 0 end) as decision_events, sum(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' then 1 else 0 end) as result_events, sum(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_success = true then 1 else 0 end) as success_calls, sum(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_success = false then 1 else 0 end) as failed_calls, sum(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_success is null then 1 else 0 end) as unknown_calls, round(100.0 * avg(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_success = true then 1.0 when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_success = false then 0.0 else null end), 2) as success_rate_pct, round(avg(case when event_name = 'codex.tool_result' then tool_duration_ms else null end), 2) as avg_duration_ms, round((percentile_cont(0.50) within group (order by tool_duration_ms))::numeric, 2) filter (where event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_duration_ms is not null) as p50_duration_ms, round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by tool_duration_ms))::numeric, 2) filter (where event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_duration_ms is not null) as p95_duration_ms, round(avg(tool_output_size), 2) filter (where event_name = 'codex.tool_result' and tool_output_size is not null) as avg_output_size from filtered group by tool_name order by result_events desc, decision_events desc, tool_name;

select $__timeGroupAlias(event_time, '5m'), tool_name as metric, round(avg(tool_duration_ms), 2) as value from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and tool_duration_ms is not null and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${conversation_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or conversation_id = ${conversation_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${tool:sqlstring} = '__all' or tool_name = ${tool:sqlstring}) group by 1, 2 order by 1;

select conversation_id, count(*) as total_calls, count(distinct tool_name) as distinct_tools, round(avg(tool_duration_ms), 2) as avg_duration_ms, round((percentile_cont(0.95) within group (order by tool_duration_ms))::numeric, 2) as p95_duration_ms, max(event_time) as last_event_time from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and conversation_id is not null and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${conversation_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or conversation_id = ${conversation_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${tool:sqlstring} = '__all' or tool_name = ${tool:sqlstring}) group by conversation_id order by last_event_time desc limit 50;

select event_time, user_id, conversation_id, tool_name, tool_call_id, model, tool_duration_ms, tool_success, tool_output_size from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${conversation_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or conversation_id = ${conversation_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${tool:sqlstring} = '__all' or tool_name = ${tool:sqlstring}) order by event_time desc limit 100;

select event_time, user_id, conversation_id, tool_name, tool_call_id, model, tool_duration_ms, tool_error_code, tool_error_message, repository from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${conversation_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or conversation_id = ${conversation_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${tool:sqlstring} = '__all' or tool_name = ${tool:sqlstring}) and tool_success = false order by event_time desc limit 50;

select event_time, user_id, conversation_id, tool_name, tool_call_id, model, tool_duration_ms, tool_success, tool_output_size from codex_tool_results_dashboard where $__timeFilter(event_time) and (${team:sqlstring} = '__all' or team = ${team:sqlstring}) and (${user_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or user_id = ${user_id:sqlstring}) and (${conversation_id:sqlstring} = '__all' or conversation_id = ${conversation_id:sqlstring}) and (${repository:sqlstring} = '__all' or repository = ${repository:sqlstring}) and (${model:sqlstring} = '__all' or model = ${model:sqlstring}) and (${tool:sqlstring} = '__all' or tool_name = ${tool:sqlstring}) and tool_duration_ms is not null order by tool_duration_ms desc, event_time desc limit 50;
